Explanation: At line 11, the variable `name` is assigned the result of `mapper.map(getUnrootedName(root, zipEntry.getName()))`. At line 13, the variable `file` is assigned a new `File` object created with `outputDir` and `name` as parameters. Since `file` is directly constructed using the value of `name`, the value of `file` used at line 15 (when `zipEntry.isDirectory()` is true) definitely depends on the value of `name` at line 11.
